integrity: The finite verifier enumerates closed neighborhood simplices from adjacency and checks all selected elementary collapses and complete mod-two ranks. General claims are based on a symbolic two-sided cover and nullhomotopy of the intersection inclusions. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact integral homotopy formula applies only to the perfect-matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs with n at least five. It is nonequivariant and does not address partial-matching deletions. Finite verification is mod two; integral conclusions follow from the homotopy-pushout proof. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Mixed-dimensional closed-neighborhood homotopy of crown graphs
